text: `usub_borrow [iN] a b c` shall require c:`i1` and return `bits_N(t)` then `i1(t < 0)`, where `t = U(a)-U(b)-U(c)`. A borrow input of one shall subtract one extra unit; hardware carry polarity shall not redefine this flag.
